This implies that being an ancestor of Leslie and a close friend of Fernando is a necessary condition for not being a great-grandfather of Perry. However, the conclusion claims that not being a great-grandfather of Perry is sufficient for being an ancestor of Leslie and a close friend of Fernando. 

The premises state that being an ancestor of Leslie and a close friend of Fernando excludes being a great-grandfather of Perry.
